lines.en: - What did you just call me? - Boo-Boo Bear.
It's one of several nicknames I made up for you.
And you can choose which one you like best,
'cause I want this to be a give-and-take.
- Okay, we went out once, and nothing happened.
- We have Cookie Tush. - Wow, just right out the gate.
And Berry Sauce. Annie Get Your Boo.
- Is this not one of those?
- Oh, my God, dude. You have to be cooler about this.
Look, I told Leslie because she's my best friend,
but if anybody finds out about this
it's gonna make it really hard to know
So just keep it on the DL, okay?
- I feel like you're embarrassed by me.
- Can't at least change my Facebook status
